features.default_selection: branding `default_image`, then catalog `default_image`, each only if the catalog has it; else you must pick
features.connectivity_check: blocks (connection-check step, skipped when this computer can copy its own system); probes the image's registry first; Network settings button; the Wi-Fi page is not in the bundled recipe
features.account_groups: wheel, sudo and developer groups (`shared/account/`), operator override
features.phone_companion: yes (TLS on the LAN address only); shows when the image needs an account, and fills the account page
features.locale_pages: language, keyboard (XKB layout and variant) and time zone (IANA) steps in the bundled recipe; listed on confirm; checked by fisherman validate
features.locale_installed: yes, for a selected value: `locale`, `keyboard.layout` and `keyboard.variant`, `timezone`
features.cancel_install: Cancel button, window close and Ctrl+Q: each asks first; a cancelled page follows
features.translatable: gettext, one domain (`bootc-installer`); branding copy stays in one language (#311)
features.source_check: confirm page, Selected image group; a blocked source holds Install
features.bootc_store_view: yes, on the confirm page; the system that this computer runs is a second install source there (experimental, never the default, never on live media)
features.source_reuse_progress: yes: a caption under the step line; the bar pulses until the first step; the cancel question says that the disk does not change
features.done_receipt: yes: install ID and first-boot check, or the reason
features.log_after_failure: yes (recovery key redacted); the page shows fisherman's `error` event, whether the disk was changed, and a cleanup that failed or timed out
features.recovery_key_not_in_log: yes (log file scrubbed; dialog and clipboard redacted)
